scorecard.rationale: No directly matched directional human Parkinson's evidence qualified. Local lexical pairs: 16. External records screened: 21. Exhaustive Round 1 screening across the local research catalog, Europe PMC, live 2026 PubMed/ClinicalTrials.gov sweeps, and Oracle/external cultural lookups found no qualifying controlled clinical or preclinical signal transferring to ground cinnamon and Parkinson dream enactment frequency. Ingredient-level cultural records (3) do not isolate dream enactment frequency. The 2017 iRBD cohort recorded sleep and other baseline symptoms. Cinnamon was one diagnostic smell item, and dream enactment was not compared as a response to cinnamon.
